verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses whether Langfuse collects product/usage telemetry or provides an opt-out mechanism (e.g., a TELEMETRY_ENABLED flag or docs on disabling anonymous usage stats); self-hosting and open-source licensing are documented but that's a different axis from telemetry opt-out. missing for 10: any documentation of a telemetry/opt-out setting, mention of anonymous usage statistics collection, or community confirmation that tracking can be disabled.
